metadata.title: Cuttack Street Food Tour I Indian Street Food I Delhi Food Walks
metadata.description:
Cuttack Street Food Tour with Anubhav Sapra

As a food destination, Odisha remains underrated and its cuisine elusive. Delhi Food Walks went on a full on street food explorations journey in Cuttack. We explored following places- 

1) Raghu Aloo Dum Dahi Bara- Bidanasi
2) Trinath Aloo Dum Dahi Bara- Kanika Square 
3) Eshwar- Biju Patnaik Chowk
4). Sen and Sen Sharbat- Chandi Mandir
5). Dil Bahar Sharbet- Buxi Bazar
6). Annapurna Mausi chakuli- Nandi shahi
7). Kalia chops and Babu Bhai Chops- Professorpada
8). Girija Hotel- Ranihat
9) Nana Hotel- Phulnakhra
10) Prakash tea stall- Buxi Bazar
11) Monu Tea Stall- Baliyatra Padia

Thank you Rohit Srivastava ( https://www.youtube.com/rohitsrivastavaa) for joining us in our food explorations in Cuttack. 

About Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks
